raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

For composite (VLM or omni) configs such as Qwen3.5 and Qwen3-VL, the language model reads its RoPE settings from a sub-config (`text_config`), and two `--json-model-override-args` forms go wrong on main `03a27e2a17`:

1. A flat `{"rope_parameters": {...}}` or `{"rope_scaling": {...}}` updates only the parent config, so the language model never sees it.
2. A nested `{"text_config": {"rope_parameters": {"rope_theta": 20000.0}}}` is applied with a shallow `update`, which replaces the whole RoPE dict and drops checkpoint keys such as `rope_type` and `partial_rotary_factor`.

Fixes #27974 (closed by the stale bot; both cases still reproduce on main).

## Modifications

`get_config` now applies overrides through `apply_model_override_args`:

1. A dict override for a key whose current value is a `PretrainedConfig` (or a dict-valued `thinker_config`, `llm_config`, `language_config` or `text_config`) is applied recursively, in place, so the sub-config object is kept.
2. Partial `rope_scaling` and `rope_parameters` dicts are merged over the existing ones instead of replacing them, one key at a time, since transformers v5 backs both with one dict. When an override names the scaling type with `rope_type` or the legacy `type`, the merge sets the other alias to the same value, so the checkpoint's old type does not win.
3. A flat RoPE dict override is also merged into the language sub-config, picked in `get_hf_text_config`'s order: `thinker_config`'s `text_config`, then `llm_config`, `language_config` and `text_config`.

Other flat overrides are applied as before.

Limits:

- A merge keeps the checkpoint keys an override does not set, so switching the scaling type keeps the old type's extra keys (for example `low_freq_factor` when switching from `llama3`). Set those keys in the override to change them.
- Only the two RoPE keys are mirrored. A flat `rope_theta` or `max_position_embeddings` still updates the parent only, as on main.
- A non-dict RoPE value such as `null` reaches the parent as on main and is not mirrored, since it would replace the sub-config's whole RoPE dict, `rope_theta` included.
- For `Llava*ForCausalLM`, `get_hf_text_config` returns the parent config, so the mirrored copy lands on a `text_config` that is not used.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A for model outputs: this changes config loading only.

At the head `e49a0555d`, on main `03a27e2a17`, with the pinned Transformers 5.19.0:

1. `python3 test/registered/unit/utils/test_hf_transformers.py`: Ran 97 tests, OK.
2. `python3 test/registered/unit/utils/test_hf_transformers_loading.py`: Ran 6 tests, OK.

For a saved default `Qwen3_5Config` (checkpoint text RoPE `{'partial_rotary_factor': 0.25, 'rope_theta': 10000.0, 'rope_type': 'default', 'type': 'default'}`), loaded through `get_config` with `rope_theta` overridden to 20000.0, the text config's `rope_parameters` are:

| Override | main | this PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| flat `rope_parameters` | unchanged, `rope_theta` 10000.0 | checkpoint keys kept, `rope_theta` 20000.0 |
| nested under `text_config` | `{'rope_theta': 20000.0}` | checkpoint keys kept, `rope_theta` 20000.0 |

`test_partial_rope_overrides_reach_loaded_qwen3_5_text_config` checks both rows and fails on main. The other new override tests cover:

- both RoPE keys in one override, since merging them in a single step would lose YaRN;
- the legacy `type` alias;
- a `null` override leaving the text config's RoPE as it was;
- the `thinker_config` path and a dict-valued `text_config`;
- no dict shared between the configs and the override args.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A: this changes config loading only.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A: no documented behavior changes.)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A: config loading only.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Validated against the production setup that motivated #27974 (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-AWQ, VLM-format config, transformers 5.3):

- **Flat form** (`--json-model-override-args '{"rope_scaling": {"rope_type": "yarn", "factor": 2.0, ...}}'`): now lands on `text_config.rope_parameters` with all checkpoint keys preserved (`rope_theta=1e7`, `mrope_section=[11,11,10]`, `mrope_interleaved`, `partial_rotary_factor=0.25`) — the partial-merge is exactly right; a wholesale replace would have broken image position encoding on this checkpoint.
- **Nested form** (the Qwen model card's documented command): no more `get_hf_text_config` AssertionError; the sub-config object stays a `PretrainedConfig`.
- Downstream dispatch verified: `get_rope` produces `YaRNScalingMRotaryEmbedding` with a 524288-position cache.

Also worth noting for backporters: the function is self-contained and ports cleanly onto pre-refactor trees (we run it on an April-based fork where this file is still `hf_transformers_utils.py`). Thanks for the fast turnaround — this removes the need for our patched-checkpoint-dir workaround.

Thanks for the thorough production validation @malaiwah — especially for confirming the partial-merge semantics against a checkpoint where a wholesale replace would have broken mrope (`mrope_section`/`mrope_interleaved` preservation was exactly the case that motivated merging instead of replacing). Good to know it also ports cleanly onto pre-refactor trees; noted for backporters.

(The command above needs authorization, so asking properly:) Could a maintainer add the `run-ci` label? This fix has been production-validated by @malaiwah on Qwen3.5-397B (comment above) — CI is the remaining gate.

Rebased and semantically woven over #33351/current main. The existing one-level nested object preservation remains; this head adds the still-missing flat text-config routing, known dict-valued text-config priority, and recursive partial rope-key merge. Transformers 5.12.1 focused assertions pass 6/6, the focused unit module passes 66 tests, and Ruff/Black/isort/py_compile are clean. No server E2E claim. Head: 0c6c2529.

On main `37678784c` the patch was still needed, and with it both RoPE override forms produce the same complete cos/sin cache as the explicitly merged reference.
Setup: the published patch (head `7c58b485a1c9`, since force-pushed) applied to main `37678784c`, Transformers 5.17.0, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu130.

| `rope_parameters` override on a saved Qwen3.5 config | main `37678784c` | with the patch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| flat | ignored (theta stays 10000) | matches the merged reference |
| partial nested (`text_config`) | loses required keys, native rotary construction fails | matches the merged reference |

The key output lines from the probe on main:

```
{"case": "flat", "result": "FAIL", "error": "10000.0"}
{"case": "nested", "result": "FAIL", "error": "Unknown RoPE scaling type, rope_scaling is {'rope_theta': 20000.0}"}
```

With the patch, `test/registered/unit/utils/test_hf_transformers.py` passes 86 tests plus 23 subtests.

<details><summary>Commands</summary>

```
# from each tree (main, and main plus the patch)
PYTHONPATH=python python probe_sglang_config_consumers.py rope
cd test && python -m pytest registered/unit/utils/test_hf_transformers.py
```

</details>

The probe script, the patch and the main and patched logs are in https://gist.github.com/waynehacking8/4b9e24fc5627d4023ee6c004f9697e28.

files.patch:
@@ -57,6 +57,103 @@ def _set_architectures(config, arch_name):
     config.update({"architectures": [arch_name]})
 
 
+_ROPE_OVERRIDE_KEYS = ("rope_scaling", "rope_parameters")
+
+# Sub-config attributes that may hold the language-model config of a
+# composite (VLM / omni) model. Mirrors the attribute priority of
+# `get_hf_text_config` in common.py.
+_TEXT_SUB_CONFIG_ATTRS = (
+    "thinker_config",
+    "llm_config",
+    "language_config",
+    "text_config",
+)
+
+
+# Unlike get_hf_text_config, selects the sub-config without normalizing its RoPE.
+def _resolve_text_sub_config(config) -> Optional[PretrainedConfig]:
+    for attr in _TEXT_SUB_CONFIG_ATTRS:
+        sub = getattr(config, attr, None)
+        if isinstance(sub, dict):
+            sub = PretrainedConfig(**sub)
+            setattr(config, attr, sub)
+        if isinstance(sub, PretrainedConfig):
+            if attr == "thinker_config":
+                inner = getattr(sub, "text_config", None)
+                if isinstance(inner, dict):
+                    inner = PretrainedConfig(**inner)
+                    sub.text_config = inner
+                if isinstance(inner, PretrainedConfig):
+                    return inner
+            return sub
+    return None
+
+
+def _merged_rope_override(config, key: str, value):
+    existing = getattr(config, key, None)
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        return value
+    if not isinstance(existing, dict):
+        return dict(value)
+    merged = {**existing, **value}
+    # "type" is the legacy alias of "rope_type": an override naming one sets
+    # the other, so the checkpoint's old type does not win.
+    for alias, other in (("rope_type", "type"), ("type", "rope_type")):
+        if alias in value and other in merged and other not in value:
+            merged[other] = value[alias]
+    return merged
+
+
+def _sub_config_for_override(config, key: str, value):
+    existing = getattr(config, key, None)
+    if (
+        key in _TEXT_SUB_CONFIG_ATTRS
+        and isinstance(value, dict)
+        and isinstance(existing, dict)
+    ):
+        existing = PretrainedConfig(**existing)
+        setattr(config, key, existing)
+    if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(existing, PretrainedConfig):
+        return existing
+    return None
+
+
+def _mirror_rope_overrides(config, rope_overrides: dict) -> None:
+    text_config = _resolve_text_sub_config(config)
+    if text_config is None:
+        return
+    for key, value in rope_overrides.items():
+        text_config.update(
+            {key: _merged_rope_override(config=text_config, key=key, value=value)}
+        )
+
+
+def apply_model_override_args(config, model_override_args: dict) -> None:
+    """Preserve sub-configs and checkpoint RoPE keys when applying CLI overrides."""
+    flat_overrides = {}
+    rope_overrides = {}
+    for key, value in model_override_args.items():
+        sub_config = _sub_config_for_override(config=config, key=key, value=value)
+        if sub_config is not None:
+            apply_model_override_args(config=sub_config, model_override_args=value)
+        elif key in _ROPE_OVERRIDE_KEYS:
+            # One key at a time: under transformers v5 both keys share one
+            # dict, so each merge has to see the previous one.
+            config.update(
+                {key: _merged_rope_override(config=config, key=key, value=value)}
+            )
+            # Mirror only dicts: a null would replace the language sub-config's
+            # whole RoPE dict, rope_theta included.
+            if isinstance(value, dict):
+                rope_overrides[key] = value
+        else:
+            flat_overrides[key] = value
+    if flat_overrides:
+        config.update(flat_overrides)
+    if rope_overrides:
+        _mirror_rope_overrides(config=config, rope_overrides=rope_overrides)
+
+
 def _apply_deepseek_ocr_overrides(config, model):
     _override_v_head_dim_if_zero(config)
     _set_architectures(config, "DeepseekOCRForCausalLM")
@@ -405,23 +502,9 @@ def get_config(
     if model_override_args:
         if isinstance(config, DeepseekV41Config):
             model_override_args = normalize_deepseek_v41_config(model_override_args)
-        # A plain update() setattrs a dict-valued override straight onto the
-        # config, so '{"text_config": {...}}' on a VLM would replace the whole

-            else:

     if is_gguf and not gguf_has_sidecar_config:
         if config.model_type not in MODEL_FOR_CAUSAL_LM_MAPPING_NAMES:

@@ -35,6 +35,7 @@
 )
 from sglang.srt.utils.hf_transformers.config import (
     _apply_gemma4_attention_overrides,
+    apply_model_override_args,
     get_config,
 )
 from sglang.srt.utils.hf_transformers.tokenizer import _fix_special_tokens_pattern
@@ -1077,5 +1078,234 @@ def test_a_later_list_may_also_cover_the_mtp_layers(self):
         self.assertEqual(len(config.mlp_layer_types), 5)
 
 
+class TestApplyModelOverrideArgs(CustomTestCase):
+    YARN = {
+        "rope_type": "yarn",
+        "factor": 4.0,
+        "original_max_position_embeddings": 8192,
+    }
+
+    def _make_composite_config(self, rope_key="rope_parameters"):
+        text_cfg = PretrainedConfig()
+        text_cfg.num_attention_heads = 8
+        rope = {
+            "rope_type": "default",
+            "rope_theta": 1e7,
+            "mrope_section": [11, 11, 10],
+        }
+        setattr(text_cfg, rope_key, rope)
+        cfg = PretrainedConfig()
+        cfg.text_config = text_cfg
+        return cfg, text_cfg
+
+    def test_partial_rope_overrides_reach_loaded_qwen3_5_text_config(self):
+        try:
+            from transformers import Qwen3_5Config
+        except ImportError:
+            self.skipTest("Qwen3_5Config requires transformers v5")
+
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as model:
+            Qwen3_5Config().save_pretrained(model)
+            original = get_hf_text_config(get_config(model, trust_remote_code=False))
+            _, checkpoint_rope = get_rope_config(original)
+            expected = {**checkpoint_rope, "rope_theta": 20000.0}
+            for override in (
+                {"rope_parameters": {"rope_theta": 20000.0}},
+                {"text_config": {"rope_parameters": {"rope_theta": 20000.0}}},
+            ):
+                with self.subTest(override=override):
+                    config = get_config(
+                        model, trust_remote_code=False, model_override_args=override
+                    )
+                    theta, params = get_rope_config(get_hf_text_config(config))
+                    self.assertEqual(theta, 20000.0)
+                    self.assertEqual(params, expected)
+
+    def test_flat_update_on_pure_text_config(self):
+        cfg = PretrainedConfig()
+        cfg.num_hidden_layers = 2
+        apply_model_override_args(
+            config=cfg, model_override_args={"num_hidden_layers": 4}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(cfg.num_hidden_layers, 4)
+
+    def test_flat_rope_scaling_mirrors_rope_parameters(self):
+        # Qwen3.5 v5 keeps checkpoint keys under rope_parameters while the
+        # documented flat override still uses rope_scaling.
+        cfg, text_cfg = self._make_composite_config("rope_parameters")
+        apply_model_override_args(
+            config=cfg, model_override_args={"rope_scaling": dict(self.YARN)}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["rope_type"], "yarn")
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["factor"], 4.0)
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["rope_theta"], 1e7)
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["mrope_section"], [11, 11, 10])
+
+    def test_flat_rope_parameters_mirrors_and_merges(self):
+        cfg, text_cfg = self._make_composite_config("rope_parameters")
+        apply_model_override_args(
+            config=cfg, model_override_args={"rope_parameters": dict(self.YARN)}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["rope_type"], "yarn")
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["factor"], 4.0)
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["rope_theta"], 1e7)
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["mrope_section"], [11, 11, 10])
+
+    def test_nested_override_recurses_into_sub_config(self):
+        # Nested rope updates retain the existing config object and keys.
+        cfg, text_cfg = self._make_composite_config()
+        apply_model_override_args(
+            config=cfg,
+            model_override_args={"text_config": {"rope_parameters": dict(self.YARN)}},
+        )
+        self.assertIsInstance(cfg.text_config, PretrainedConfig)
+        self.assertIs(cfg.text_config, text_cfg)
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.num_attention_heads, 8)
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["rope_type"], "yarn")
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["rope_theta"], 1e7)
+
+    def test_nested_non_rope_override(self):
+        cfg, text_cfg = self._make_composite_config()
+        apply_model_override_args(
+            config=cfg, model_override_args={"text_config": {"num_attention_heads": 16}}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.num_attention_heads, 16)
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["rope_type"], "default")
+
+    def test_flat_rope_update_prefers_dict_llm_config(self):
+        cfg, lower_priority_text_cfg = self._make_composite_config()
+        cfg.llm_config = {
+            "num_attention_heads": 8,
+            "rope_parameters": {
+                "rope_type": "default",
+                "rope_theta": 1e7,
+            },
+        }
+        apply_model_override_args(
+            config=cfg, model_override_args={"rope_parameters": dict(self.YARN)}
+        )
+        self.assertIsInstance(cfg.llm_config, PretrainedConfig)
+        self.assertEqual(cfg.llm_config.rope_parameters["rope_type"], "yarn")
+        self.assertEqual(cfg.llm_config.rope_parameters["rope_theta"], 1e7)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            lower_priority_text_cfg.rope_parameters["rope_type"], "default"
+        )
+
+    def test_flat_rope_override_reaches_thinker_text_config(self):
+        # Omni configs keep the language model under thinker_config.text_config.
+        cfg, text_cfg = self._make_composite_config()
+        thinker = PretrainedConfig()
+        thinker.text_config = {
+            "rope_parameters": {"rope_type": "default", "rope_theta": 1e6}
+        }
+        cfg.thinker_config = thinker
+        apply_model_override_args(
+            config=cfg, model_override_args={"rope_parameters": dict(self.YARN)}
+        )
+        inner = cfg.thinker_config.text_config
+        self.assertIsInstance(inner, PretrainedConfig)
+        self.assertEqual(inner.rope_parameters["rope_type"], "yarn")
+        self.assertEqual(inner.rope_parameters["rope_theta"], 1e6)
+        self.assertEqual(text_cfg.rope_parameters["rope_type"], "default")
+
+    def test_nested_override_converts_dict_sub_config(self):
+        cfg = PretrainedConfig()
+        cfg.text_config = {
+            "num_attention_heads": 8,
+            "rope_parameters": {"rope_type": "default", "rope_theta": 1e7},
+        }
+        apply_model_override_args(
+            config=cfg,
+            model_override_args={
+                "text_config": {"rope_parameters": {"rope_theta": 2e7}}
+            },
+        )
+        self.assertIsInstance(cfg.text_config, PretrainedConfig)
+        self.assertEqual(cfg.text_config.num_attention_heads, 8)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            cfg.text_config.rope_parameters,
+            {"rope_type": "default", "rope_theta": 2e7},
+        )
+
+    def test_dict_override_of_non_sub_config_key_is_flat(self):
+        # A dict-valued key that is not a sub-config (here vision_config held
+        # as a dict) is still a plain flat update.
+        cfg = PretrainedConfig()
+        cfg.vision_config = {"hidden_size": 10, "patch": 14}
+        apply_model_override_args(
+            config=cfg, model_override_args={"vision_config": {"hidden_size": 20}}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(cfg.vision_config, {"hidden_size": 20})
+
+    def test_legacy_type_alias_override_sets_rope_type(self):
+        # Older recipes (Qwen2.5's YaRN example) name the scaling type with the
+        # legacy "type" key; the checkpoint's "rope_type" must not win the merge.
+        model = self._qwen3_5_config_dir()
+        yarn = {k: v for k, v in self.YARN.items() if k != "rope_type"}
+        config = get_config(
+            model,
+            trust_remote_code=False,
+            model_override_args={"rope_scaling": {"type": "yarn", **yarn}},
+        )
+        _, params = get_rope_config(get_hf_text_config(config))
+        self.assertEqual(params["rope_type"], "yarn")
+        self.assertEqual(params["type"], "yarn")
+
+    def test_override_dict_is_not_shared_between_configs(self):
+        cfg, text_cfg = self._make_composite_config()
+        override = {"rope_parameters": dict(self.YARN)}
+        apply_model_override_args(config=cfg, model_override_args=override)
+        self.assertIsNot(cfg.rope_parameters, override["rope_parameters"])
+        self.assertIsNot(text_cfg.rope_parameters, override["rope_parameters"])
+        self.assertIsNot(cfg.rope_parameters, text_cfg.rope_parameters)
+
+    def _qwen3_5_config_dir(self):
+        try:
+            from transformers import Qwen3_5Config
+        except ImportError:
+            self.skipTest("Qwen3_5Config requires transformers v5")
+        model = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.addCleanup(model.cleanup)
+        Qwen3_5Config().save_pretrained(model.name)
+        return model.name
+
+    def test_both_rope_keys_in_one_override_keep_each_other(self):
+        # Under transformers v5 rope_scaling and rope_parameters share one
+        # dict, so the second key must merge over the first, not replace it.
+        from transformers import LlamaConfig
+
+        override = {
+            "rope_scaling": dict(self.YARN),
+            "rope_parameters": {"rope_theta": 20000.0},
+        }
+        llama = LlamaConfig()
+        apply_model_override_args(config=llama, model_override_args=override)
+        model = self._qwen3_5_config_dir()
+        config = get_config(
+            model, trust_remote_code=False, model_override_args=override
+        )
+        text_config = get_hf_text_config(config)
+        for cfg in (llama, text_config):
+            theta, params = get_rope_config(cfg)
+            self.assertEqual(theta, 20000.0)
+            self.assertEqual(params["rope_type"], "yarn")
+            self.assertEqual(params["factor"], 4.0)
+        self.assertEqual(get_rope_config(text_config)[1]["partial_rotary_factor"], 0.25)
+
+    def test_null_rope_override_leaves_text_config_rope(self):
+        # Only dict overrides are merged into the language sub-config; a null
+        # must not wipe its rope_theta and partial_rotary_factor.
+        model = self._qwen3_5_config_dir()
+        expected = get_rope_config(
+            get_hf_text_config(get_config(model, trust_remote_code=False))
+        )
+        config = get_config(
+            model,
+            trust_remote_code=False,
+            model_override_args={"rope_scaling": None},
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(get_rope_config(get_hf_text_config(config)), expected)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()

Validated against the production setup that motivated #27974 (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-AWQ, VLM-format config, transformers 5.3):

- **Flat form** (`--json-model-override-args '{"rope_scaling": {"rope_type": "yarn", "factor": 2.0, ...}}'`): now lands on `text_config.rope_parameters` with all checkpoint keys preserved (`rope_theta=1e7`, `mrope_section=[11,11,10]`, `mrope_interleaved`, `partial_rotary_factor=0.25`) — the partial-merge is exactly right; a wholesale replace would have broken image position encoding on this checkpoint.
- **Nested form** (the Qwen model card's documented command): no more `get_hf_text_config` AssertionError; the sub-config object stays a `PretrainedConfig`.
- Downstream dispatch verified: `get_rope` produces `YaRNScalingMRotaryEmbedding` with a 524288-position cache.
